hero.role: Quantum Systems Architect & AI Ethics Chair
hero.talkTitle: "The Last Analog Thought: Preserving Human Consciousness in an Algorithmic Age"
hero.bio: As neural synthesis advances, what remains irreversibly human? Dr. El-Kattan takes the stage to examine the boundary between synthetic intelligence, human curiosity, and biological intuition — dismantling comfortable assumptions from the red circle.

list.name: Dr. Laila Mansour
list.talkTitle: "Neural Horizons: Rewiring Memory & Empathy Through Silicon"
list.shortDesc: Exploring how next-generation brain-computer interfaces can restore human emotional equilibrium and unlock dormant potential.
list.bio: Dr. Laila Mansour leads breakthrough investigations in brain-computer interfaces in Cairo. Her work bridges neural mapping with generative computational empathy, exploring how biological memory can be enhanced without sacrificing psychological authenticity.

list.name: Karim Hegazy
list.shortDesc: How vernacular Egyptian building techniques and photosynthetic materials turn dense urban heat islands into regenerative ecosystems.
list.bio: Karim Hegazy is an award-winning architect pioneering vernacular biophilic structures across Egypt. His practice merges historical Nubian and Coptic passive-cooling engineering with photosynthetic carbon-capturing concrete.

list.name: Nouran El-Gohary
list.talkTitle: "The Geometry of Voice: Translating Arabic Poetry into 3D Space"
list.shortDesc: Blending centuries-old Kufic calligraphy rules with procedural algorithmic physics to create kinetic typographic sculptures.
list.bio: Nouran El-Gohary explores the mathematical symmetry of classical Arabic typography. Her interactive spatial computing installations transform spoken word and tonal poetry into real-time physical sculptures.

list.name: Amina Zaki
list.talkTitle: "The Audacity to Build: Unlocking 1,000 Unseen Talents in the Delta"
list.shortDesc: Unpacking the real micro-mechanics of turning high-potential youth from grassroots communities into global technical founders.
list.bio: Amina Zaki has spearheaded educational incubation hubs across secondary schools in the Nile Delta, training over 1,000 young problem solvers in venture creation, public rhetoric, and community leadership.

list.name: Ziad Abdel-Rahman
list.talkTitle: "Decentralized Trust: Reclaiming Digital Sovereignty in the South"
list.shortDesc: A critical analysis of global data colonialism and the mathematical framework needed for sovereign Middle Eastern digital infrastructure.
list.bio: Ziad Abdel-Rahman is a leading cryptographer advocating for open, decentralized computing protocols in emerging markets, shielding critical civil infrastructure from global surveillance and monopoly.

list.name: Salma Farouk
list.talkTitle: "Solar Harvesting at Molecular Scale: Breaking the 40% Barrier"
list.shortDesc: How perovskite crystal synthesis developed in local laboratories is democratizing zero-loss clean solar energy for developing nations.
list.bio: Salma Farouk is a pioneering materials scientist who developed low-cost synthetic perovskite solar cells, enabling high-efficiency clean power generation in arid and remote desert territories.

cta.title: Have An Idea Worth Spreading?
cta.desc: We operate a year-round speaker curation academy. If you have an authentic insight, transformative research, or a local idea that demands a global stage, step forward.
